decision: Seven approved records were excluded on 2026-10-20 because the provider sanitiser would damage their text; each exclusion says to publish after the text is repaired. These exact repairs apply only to the v2 record of the named sources. The original FGDC XML is unchanged and stays attached.
rule: This collection stores Latin-1 letters as U+FF00 plus the Latin-1 byte (U+FFE4 for a-umlaut, U+FFE9 for e-acute, U+FFFC for u-umlaut); the sanitiser deletes U+FFFC and folds U+FFE4/U+FFE9, so names would be published damaged. A "<" directly followed by a letter is read by the sanitiser as an HTML tag and stripped together with the text after it; one space after "<" keeps the comparison as text. A C1 control character U+0097 is the cp1252 byte for an em dash; the sanitiser stores it as U+2014, so the v2 record carries U+2014 (FGDC-885, 2674, 3808; found by the bulk-020 reviewer, 2026-10-22).
decided_by: Claude Opus 5.5 operator (session a49e1cd3), 2026-10-22, to be confirmed by an independent reviewer agent
